[LCST.4.1.5] **Chaining.** A chain `x::A::B` applies each conversion left to right,
threading nullability per [LCST.4.3.1]: the result of `x::A` is the source of `::B`, so if
`x::A` is nullable then `::B` must carry `?`. `x::Int?::Float` is therefore a compile error
(nullable source, bare target; `DS_VALIDATE_CAST_NULLABILITY`, [LCST.4.3.2]); the author
writes `x::Int?::Float?`.
